title: Night Cream Mistakes to Avoid: 7 Habits That Hold Skin Back
ex: Applying on an unwashed face, washing it off too soon, using too much: the night cream mistakes most people make, and the simple fixes.
rt: Night Cream Mistakes to Avoid: 7 Easy Fixes | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream mistakes to avoid: using it without washing your face, how long to leave night cream on, and whether to wash your face in the morning after.
quick: Always cleanse before night cream, use a pea-sized amount, apply it 20 to 30 minutes before bed and leave it on until morning. Use one active product per night, wash your face gently in the morning and wear sunscreen. Give a cream eight to twelve weeks before judging it.
facts: Night cream is meant to stay on all night
Cleanse first so you do not trap sweat and sunscreen
A morning wash and sunscreen complete the routine
Skin renews roughly every 4 to 6 weeks, so be patient
